Kairox Systems combines the speed of aerial drones and the stealth of underwater drones into one vehicle. We can look for mines in a strait, fly out of the water to inspect a coastline, and then engage maritime threats in one go. 

Joel, Alex, and Jorge all met at MIT. After conversations with warfighters and drone researchers, they decided to create a vehicle unlike any before: A long-range vehicle that is truly amphibious, low-cost enough for one-way swarms, can operate fully autonomously, and can be repurposed on the front lines. A drop-in module that integrates with existing Ardupilot, INAV and PX4 flight controllers, with demonstrated satellite-independent autonomous flight and GPS handoff. We're currently working with commercial and military end users to deploy the capability.

Graphide keeps a live graph of the modules, classes, functions, etc. how they connect, and what each agent is touching as it works. Graphide then checks their changes against your architecture, making sure your agents are implementing what you had in mind.

Owners bank a healthy baseline for their dog and track changes every year. Dogs already diagnosed get personalized monitoring through treatment. Our mission is to make pet cancer curable through early detection and monitoring.

name: Hundred

In the consumer electronics industry, designs change so fast that traditional machine vision can't keep up, forcing factories to rely on manual inspection, literally people checking parts under microscopes to sort out bad parts. long_description:

Today agents use computers the way people do. They take screenshots and click through apps, which is slow, expensive, and brittle. In Tilo, every app exports actions, so agents work over MCP while people use the UI. You still see what each agent does in your apps, and anything it changes can be undone.

Our mission is to put practice operations on autopilot and keep every chair filled.

With Kiwi, every agent is self-improving, and cites the SQL query and data snapshot pulled from the Kiwi GTM brain used to produce every output. Kiwi enables GTM teams to be fully AI-native.

name: DeepMark
one_liner: A live watermark inside AI voice that survives phone calls
long_description: DeepMark is the authentication layer for AI voice. When an AI agent speaks, we embed a compact, machine-readable ID directly into the audio, not in metadata, which gets stripped the moment a file is touched. The ID resolves to a trust record, so a bank, a call center, or the person on the line can verify in real time who the agent is.

name: Wondersearch

Unlike vector databases and RAG stacks, there's no pipeline to build or maintain: connect your files and data, and they're searchable right away.
